name_reason: Compliant with fd2_<domain>_<descriptor> (domain=animate, descriptor=warp_teleport_char). Accurately reflects purpose: full character warp/teleport visual sequence that also performs the actual position write into runtime_char. No Ghidra address residue in the name.
purpose: Plays the full character warp/teleport animation (source-side portal-open + collapse, row-by-row pop-in at destination, destination-side expand) and writes the unit's new tile position into runtime_char.
logic_summary: Loads the warp SFX bank (FDOTHER.DAT[0x51]); mallocs a 0x25680-byte backdrop snapshot and captures the battle scene via fd2_composite_battle_tile_map. Opens a portal at the destination tile (fd2_animate_warp_portal_open_at), computes the warp-in sprite pointer from portrait_sheet[0x1F6], and derives source pixel coords from the battle cursor (cursor_screen_x*0x18+0xC, cursor_screen_y*0x18+0xF). Plays warp SFX with a same-tile flag (set when new_pos == dst_tile), runs the source-side collapse (fd2_animate_warp_out_collapse, returns a band radius), then writes new_pos_x/new_pos_y into runtime_char[char_slot].pos_x/pos_y (the actual teleport). Restores the backdrop, draws a filled-circle band at the source, then copies 0x18-byte rows from the working surface into the mode-13h framebuffer at the destination tile (row_count 0x18, or 0x12 with shifted src/dst start when the destination is on the view-window top edge), with a 10ms delay per row. Finishes with the destination-side expand (fd2_animate_warp_in_expand) and frees the snapshot and SFX buffers. Returns via tail-JMP into the shared Watcom epilogue at 0x18888.
signature: void fd2_animate_warp_teleport_char(uint32 char_slot, uint32 new_pos_x, uint32 new_pos_y, uint32 dst_tile_x, uint32 dst_tile_y)

params.name: param_1
params.semantics: runtime_char_array index of the unit being warped; used as the struct base whose pos_x/pos_y are overwritten with the new tile after the source-side collapse.
params.reason: param_1 is a generic Ghidra placeholder; caller fd2_cast_spell_17_complex passes *p_target_byte (target unit id) and fd2_cinematic_warp_char_to_tile passes char_id. Source already names it char_slot.

params.name: param_2
params.semantics: Destination tile X written into runtime_char[char_slot].pos_x (the actual teleport). Spell 0x17 first call passes 0xFF (off-map vanish); cinematic passes the target tile X.
params.reason: Generic Ghidra placeholder; this is the new position X stored into the runtime_char struct. Source already names it new_pos_x.

params.name: param_3
params.semantics: Destination tile Y written into runtime_char[char_slot].pos_y (the actual teleport). Spell 0x17 first call passes 0xFF; cinematic passes the target tile Y.
params.reason: Generic Ghidra placeholder; this is the new position Y stored into the runtime_char struct. Source already names it new_pos_y.

params.name: char_idx
params.semantics: Destination tile X for the framebuffer math (subtracted from battle_view_window_origin_x to compute row offset and src/dst surface addresses); also forwarded to fd2_animate_warp_portal_open_at / collapse / expand as the destination tile X.
params.reason: Ghidra name char_idx is misleading -- it is NOT a character index; it is the destination tile X used in framebuffer address math. Source already names it dst_tile_x.

params.name: dst_x
params.semantics: Destination tile Y for the framebuffer math (subtracted from battle_view_window_origin_y; drives the top-edge row_count=0x12 special case) and forwarded as destination tile Y to the portal/collapse/expand helpers.
params.reason: Ghidra name dst_x is misleading -- it carries the destination tile Y, not X. Source already names it dst_tile_y.

returns.semantics: No return value. Side effects: writes runtime_char[char_slot].pos_x/pos_y, mutates the large_game_state_buffer working surface and the mode-13h framebuffer, plays SFX. Control returns via tail-JMP into the shared epilogue at 0x18888.
